inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Stoneveil, a vast cave where a tribe of blood priests holds its rites, lit by glowing red crystals and torches, where everything down here wants your blood. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. One whole region shown as one wide connected panorama, read left to right in three places: the cave mouth, then the blood pools, then the blood priest's altar. Bare at the left, more and more built up toward the chief's place at the right end. Every part continues into the next with the same light, the same horizon and the same floor; nothing is repeated.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth", "lighting": "Warm torchlight and glowing red crystals from the upper left, cool teal bounce light, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the cave floor in calm even light, bright and readable, never murky.", "color_palette": ["#1c1426", "#3a2240", "#5a2a4a", "#8a2a3a", "#d23a4a", "#ff6a6a", "#f2a24a", "#ffd27a", "#2a6a6a", "#4ab0a0", "#7a6a8a", "#a89ab0", "#e8dcd0", "#8a94a8", "#6e7890"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage panorama seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no people. The top part is sky above a distant horizon with the region's landmark. Behind the arena the scenery stands in overlapping rows at different depths, with one big set piece for each of the three places and low framing pieces in the near foreground. The lower part is one flat calm arena floor running the whole width.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 260, 1000], "desc": "the high dark ceiling of a vast cavern, hung with long red crystal stalactites glowing softly"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [143, 0, 442, 1000], "desc": "the far wall of the vast cavern in deep violet rock with thin red waterfalls falling into the dark, and high on it at the right end a colossal red handprint painted on the rock, glowing faintly, the region's landmark"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [364, 0, 559, 1000], "desc": "behind the arena: dark basalt pillars, clusters of red glowing crystals, bone altars, stalagmites with little fanged mouths, chains hanging from the ceiling, sparse at the left and denser toward the altar"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [195, 92, 611, 242], "desc": "the first place, the bare outskirts: the jagged cave mouth with pale daylight spilling in, a crooked wooden sign that says BLOOD BANK, and a leech the size of a dog asleep on a rock"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [39, 399, 625, 600], "desc": "the second place, one big set piece: a wide pool of glowing red blood fed by a carved stone fountain shaped like a screaming face, giant leeches lounging at its edge like bathers"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 714, 625, 959], "desc": "the blood priest's altar at the right end: a towering stepped altar of black
